description: This file implements subtitle processing functions for normalization, correction, generation, translation, and validation in a subtitle processing system. It includes functions for handling subtitle files, normalizing whitespace and timings, generating placeholder subtitles from videos, translating subtitles in a naive manner, and validating subtitle content.

methods.name: str run_quality_check_and_correct( subtitle_path: str, video_path: Optional[str], language: Optional[str], enforce_ott: bool, processed_dir: str, )
methods.description: Runs basic checks and 'corrects' a subtitle file by normalizing whitespace, fixing overlaps, and enforcing maximum two lines per caption if specified.

methods.name: str generate_subtitles_for_video( video_path: str, language: Optional[str], processed_dir: str, model_hint: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Generates placeholder subtitle content for a given video, simulating speech-to-text output.

methods.name: str translate_subtitles( subtitle_path: str, target_language: str, source_language: Optional[str], processed_dir: str, model_hint: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Pretends to translate subtitles by appending the target language to each text line in the subtitle file.

methods.name: List[str] validate_subtitles(subtitle_path: str, options: Dict)
methods.description: Performs basic validation checks on subtitle files such as character count per line, number of lines per caption, and presence of empty blocks.
